name: error-logs
description: Logs de niveau ERROR ou plus dans le namespace demo au cours des 5 dernières minutes

query_condition.sql: SELECT service_name, coalesce(exception_type, body) AS error, coalesce('(' || translate(max(exception_message), '"''', '') || ')', '') AS message, count(*) AS occurrences FROM "default" WHERE k8s_namespace_name = 'demo' AND severity_number >= 17 GROUP BY service_name, coalesce(exception_type, body)
